description.en: Turns a verified phase into a pull request: checks the verification passed and the full gate marker, lists untriaged vendor updates, pushes the branch, writes the PR body from the phase book and opens it, records the shipment and runs the post-ship hooks.
description.ru: Превращает проверенную фазу в pull request: проверяет, что проверка пройдена и есть метка полных ворот, перечисляет неразобранные обновления зависимостей, пушит ветку, пишет описание PR по книге фазы и открывает его, записывает отгрузку и запускает хуки после отгрузки.

ru: Сделай PR из работы этой фазы
Подготовь PR с описанием по книге фазы
en: Ship the phase as a pull request
Make a PR from this phase's work
Prepare a PR with the body from the phase book
Push the branch and open the PR

nodes.prompt: Verification passed? (lane_pilot_phase status: acceptance lines all hold). Full-gate marker: the integration gate ran green on the head being shipped. Untriaged vendor updates: dependency bumps in the diff without a note. Return held_by with every missing item.

Push the phase branch (git push -u origin HEAD), write the PR body from the phase's SUMMARY.md and BOOK.md (what, why, how it was verified, receipts), open it with gh pr create, record the shipment in .agents/deploys.log, then run .agents/planning/hooks/post-ship*.md if any (lane-plan render-hooks post-ship).

nodes.rule: validateDeliverable on the artifact the run produced: the deliverable/validator/brief inputs name what to check; a fail means the goal is not met
